title: Yeti Summit Series Lemon Lime Ice 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Yeti Summit Lemon Lime Ice delivers a bright, zesty vape with the sharp tang of Lemon and the sweeter bite of Lime working in perfect harmony. This timeless citrus duo brings a refreshing lift, complemented by a brisk wave of menthol that keeps the flavour feeling clean and crisp from start to finish. Formulated with nicotine salts, this e-liquid provides rapid nicotine delivery and a smooth, tactile throat hit, ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping with low-powered pod systems and starter kits. The 50VG/50PG ratio ensures consistent flavour clarity and discreet vapour for all-day use. Part of the double-concentrated Yeti Summit Series, this nic salt is designed to deliver maximum flavour with an unmistakable icy kick. With three nicotine strengths to choose from, it’s a longer-lasting, lower-waste option for vapers looking to move beyond disposables.
